items.name: Roasted chicken drumstick, skin-on, herb-seasoned (edible meat and skin, bone excluded)
items.preparation: oven-roasted with skin, seasoned with herbs and spices

items.name: Cooking oil or light dressing (implied by roasting, sautéing and dressed greens)
items.preparation: oil on the chicken skin, on the green beans and on the arugula

scale_cues: Large white square dinner plate (about 27 cm wide); the drumstick bone tip and rice grain size helped judge portions; no cutlery or hand visible
assumptions: The chicken piece is a drumstick, and the bone is excluded from the weight
The rice is plain with no butter
About 5 g of total oil is assumed from cooking and dressing, since the chicken skin and greens look slightly glossy
The few strands among the green beans are trimmed stems, not counted separately
